text:
marta: quick sync — we need to lock the observability slice for next quarter. customers keep asking for three things: cheaper per-token cost visibility, fast error triage, and lightweight traces for hot paths. can we scope an MVP that satisfies enterprise asks without blowing effort on full tracing?
aj: +1. propose 'economics-first' surface: start with per-route + model cost breakdown in the console, then add a small set of tracing hooks for top 3 latency hotspots.
liam: agree on phased approach. concrete ask: dashboards (MVP) = per-route cost, median P95 latency, error-rate by model version, sample request payload link. visuals need to be embeddable into customer reports.
devon: question — how do we define "top 3 latency hotspots"? by QPS * p95 latency across model routes? or by customer-reported incidents?
marta: use a hybrid heuristic: (QPS * p95) as primary signal, then overlay manual customer-critical tags. that'll surface high-economic-impact hotspots first.
aj: acceptance criteria suggestion for MVP dashboards:
- live per-route cost card (last 30d) with top contributors and delta vs prior 30d
- latency distribution chart (median/P95/P99) with ability to zoom into a time window
- error-rate waterfall per model version with link to sample traces or raw logs
- export CSV and a small API endpoint for programmatic pulls
liam: +1. add: export should include token breakdown (prompt vs completion) so finance teams can map dollars to features.
devon: tracing hooks scope proposal:
- only instrument hot-paths chosen by the heuristic (3 per deployment)
- lightweight spans, no full distributed baggage by default
- attach a sampled request_id and quick KV of model selection/quantization profile
- sampling rate configurable per-customer and per-route (default 0.1%)
liam: that's reasonable. what's the rollout plan? canary to 10% internal traffic, then 50% customers opting in, then GA?
marta: tentative plan: dev environment demo -> internal canary (10%) for 2 weeks -> opt-in beta with 5 pilot customers -> GA once we hit stability and costs under control.
aj: what are the metrics to gate GA? minimal list:
- tracing overhead <= 1.5% added p95 latency on hot-paths
- observability infra cost increase < 8% of baseline (first month)
- at least 3 pilot customers confirm improved triage time (quantitative or anecdotal)
devon: how do we measure "triage time" for pilots? propose: pilot engineers keep a timestamped triage log for 30 days (ticket opened -> root cause identified). we can compare baseline vs after hooks.
liam: curious about error analytics: we should include automatic grouping by stack and model output diffs (e.g., when outputs change across model versions). even a simple hash-based grouping helps.
aj: agreed — start with simple grouping: exception stack + model fingerprint. advanced diffing can be v2.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: observability-mvp branch deployed to staging at 2024-10-03T14:12Z :white_check_mark:
marta: nice — once staging is green, schedule a 30-minute demo for PMs + ENG + SRE. i'll sync with solutions eng to line up pilot customers.
devon: FYI, we should add a small UI affordance: 'why am I seeing this cost' hover that links to request sampling example and billing docs. reduces support churn.
liam: timeline asks: can we aim for an internal canary in 6 weeks? engineering capacity permitting.
aj: i'll map out a sprint plan: 2 sprints for dashboard backend + cost aggregation, 1 sprint for front-end cards, 1 sprint for tracing hook runtime + sampling controls. might be tight but doable if we deprioritize noncritical viz.
marta: good. please drop a short PRD link here when you have it. i want the acceptance gates and pilot checklist in the doc.
aj: PRD draft -> https://docs.internal/redwood/observability-econ-first-mvp (will update)
devon: one last note: require a kill-switch at org-level for tracing (compliance). add to acceptance criteria.
marta: added. thanks everyone. cc @liam if you want to lead pilot onboarding.
liam: happy to. i'll pull together pilot invites and a short questionnaire for customers to capture current triage metrics.
ops-bot: reminder: next product sync Thu 10:00 — add this as agenda item 'obs-mvp acceptance check'
marta: end of thread — i'll convert decisions to a one-pager and assign owners. :rocket:
